name: Loratadine

similar.name: Eszopiclone
problems: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for misuse or addiction

fda.text: Do not use if you have ever had an allergic reaction to this product or any of its ingredients Ask a doctor before use if you have liver or kidney disease. Your doctor should determine if you need a different dose. When using this product do not take more than directed. Taking more than directed may cause drowsiness.…

summary: A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave Loratadine high scores for possible heart and liver risks [M]. Official warnings state that you should not use this medicine if you have ever had an allergic reaction to it or its ingredients [4]. You should also check with a doctor before taking it if you have liver or kidney disease to see if you need a different amount [4]. Finally, the label warns not to take more than directed, as doing so may cause sleepiness [4].
